tweets.text:
Tesla's robotaxi will grow rapidly. 

I love Elon's little marketing hacks, like $4.20 flat fee for rides and "Just kidding" when a user tips.

Like I said, for $UBER, this is the equivalent of 2007's iPhone launch for Blackberry, but remember, it takes time. Uber will likely have its best years ever for the next 2-3 years (just like Blackberry) before the inevitable downfall starts to happen. 

Waymo (and other AVs) will NOT save Uber. Travis (the founder of Uber) understood this well. While @dkhos has been great for cleaning up Uber's culture problems and getting it to profitability, he's totally missing the boat on Robotaxis. The ship is about to sail and there will be no catching up.

Uber has one-shot: build the tech in-house, and launch the tech using low-cost EV vehicles. The only way to catch up is to buy an existing EV company that already has a low-cost vehicle and is about to manufacture it at scale. And that's $RIVN. Of course, it's not gonna happen. And therefore, Uber will eventually become irrelevant - or as relevant as Blackberry is today, 18 years after the iPhone launch.
